title: Maharlika corn (M315): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Maharlika corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Maharlika corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Mindanao. About 109 days to harvest, 7.6 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: Maharlika corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as M315 or Maharlika 315. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2025 as NSIC 2025 DR Cn 01. RJR Agro Industrial Enterprises bred it. It takes about 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 7.6 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for M315 or Maharlika 315, this is the same corn. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry, with notes from its seller and farm sources. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Maharlika corn takes about 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 3.8 days longer than the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 7.6 t/ha trails the average of its group, 8.13. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 109 in NSIC trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ear length in the trials: WS= 12.4 and DS=11.54. The shelling recovery was WS 75.02 percent and DS 76.27 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** NSIC trials averaged 7.87 t/ha (wet season) and 7.33 (dry season) in Mindanao.
**Traits in the seed:** Registry says lab tests found the NK603 (glyphosate tolerance) and MON810 (corn borer protection) events, picked up through cross pollination with GM corn.
Shelling about 75 to 76 percent in NSIC trials.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: rJR's yellow entry in DA Northern Mindanao's 2023 corn derbies in Bukidnon. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Maharlika corn

The registry recommends it for Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is M315 the same as Maharlika?
items.a: Yes. M315 is another name for Maharlika, registered as NSIC 2025 DR Cn 01. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 7.6 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
The registry recommends it for Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Maharlika?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
